findings.issue: Cloudflare origin cert and private key written to disk via echo heredoc — multi-line secrets can appear in GitHub Actions logs if shell fails
findings.impact: TLS private key and origin certificate could be exposed in CI logs, compromising TLS security for the production domain
findings.fix: Use GitHub Actions secrets directly in environment files ($GITHUB_ENV), or write secrets to files using GitHub Actions file commands

findings.issue: CI/CD secrets injected into .env files via inline echo commands — shell parsing errors can expose secrets in build logs
findings.impact: Multiple secrets (Supabase keys, VAPID keys) could appear in CI logs if shell expansion fails
findings.fix: Use env: block in docker compose or GitHub Actions environment files; avoid echo-based secret injection

findings.issue: Workflows do not declare explicit GITHUB_TOKEN permissions — defaulting to write-all broad permissions
findings.impact: If a workflow is compromised (e.g., via malicious PR), the GITHUB_TOKEN has write access to all repository resources
findings.fix: Add explicit permissions: block to every workflow: contents: read, issues: read, pull-requests: read, actions: read

findings.issue: No production approval gate — push to main or workflow_dispatch immediately deploys to production without manual approval step
findings.impact: Any code merged to main or anyone with dispatch access can deploy to production with zero human review
findings.fix: Add environment: production with required reviewers to the deploy job; add 'prod-approval' environment protection rule in GitHub

findings.issue: GitHub branch protection rules are not actually enforced — validate.yml only read-checks but doesn't apply them; no required status checks on main
findings.impact: PRs can merge to main without passing lint, tests, or audit gates; no CI enforcement at all
findings.fix: Configure branch protection via Terraform github_branch_protection resource or GitHub API; add audit-gate as required check

findings.issue: GITHUB_TOKEN piped to docker login via echo — full token exposed in SSH session commands
findings.impact: GITHUB_TOKEN with write:packages scope visible in SSH history; could be harvested from compromised droplet
findings.fix: Pass GITHUB_TOKEN as environment variable to SSH script instead of inlining in command

findings.issue: deploy-production.yml triggers on any push to main — no path filtering to ensure only relevant changes trigger a production deploy
findings.impact: A README change to main triggers a full production deploy with image build, SSH, and container restart
findings.fix: Add paths filter to deploy-production.yml trigger: paths: ['apps/', 'packages/', 'infra/', 'supabase/', 'scripts/']

findings.issue: No artifact retention policy documented — build artifacts use GitHub Actions defaults (90 days)
findings.impact: Build artifacts with potentially sensitive intermediate data retained unnecessarily
findings.fix: Set artifact retention to 7 days for CI builds, 30 days for release builds; document retention policy
